name: @varunindiit/create-expo-starter
description: Production-ready Expo (SDK 56) starter: expo-router auth flow with session persistence, bottom tabs, Redux Toolkit + RTK Query, light/dark theming, i18n, SecureStore, typed API layer with token refresh, and a tested component library.
